executiveSummary: Analysis covers 100 Advanced Core matches under Engine v4.2.6 / Rules v4.2.0. All matches completed without aborts. Highest win rate: hybrix-sniper at 91.7% (CI [0.646, 0.985], 12 games). No synergy pairs reached statistical significance after FDR correction. 106 mechanic(s) measured with evidence-backed associations. 27 anomaly/anomalies flagged (0 critical, 5 warning, 22 info). Data completeness: PASS (no unclassified facts). Mechanics and synergy outputs are policy-, seat-, profile-, and telemetry-conditioned. They are evidence-backed associations, not automatic canon or balance changes. Win association is not causal proof. Synergy interaction is the A×B odds-ratio from a stratified logistic model.

participant-prevalence.formula: unique participant-match pairs that selected entity ≥1 / all eligible participant-match records

match-prevalence.formula: unique matches in which entity selected ≥1 / all eligible matches

pick-rate-when-legal.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval; N/A when zero legal opportunities

counter-efficiency.formula: opponent value prevented / own card and tempo cost

synergy-interaction.formula: stratified logistic A×B interaction (odds-ratio scale) from four-cohort model
synergy-interaction.uncertainty: Wald CI from inverse-variance pooled SE + BH FDR

immediate-point-impact.formula: sum actor-perspective secured point delta / resolved selections with point data

adjusted-win-association.formula: stratified win-rate differential controlling for policy, seat, profile

interpretationBoundary: Mechanics and synergy outputs are policy-, seat-, profile-, and telemetry-conditioned. They are evidence-backed associations, not automatic canon or balance changes. recommendations: Most synergy findings are inconclusive — consider increasing match count for statistical power.
